title: Shiraishi An — Gotta Be An English Master!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's see... “Join: to take part in a collective activity”...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We sang in a music event today, so...
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Keeping a diary is easy, but having to write in English is so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I get why you're excited...
But have you done your English homework due tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We don't have practice today, so please make sure that you do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Toya and Akito went out of their way to warn me, so I gotta do this properly...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Oh, I'm starting to doze off...
I feel like this takes up more energy than an event.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll rest my eyes for five minutes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They say that a little rest can help recharge your brain... A lot...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't “huh” us.
What are you spacing out for?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(What am I doing in the park...?!
I was just writing my assignment—)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, did you hear anything we said just now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Uhh... Sorry!
What were we talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We were asking whether or not you did your English homework, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I think I fell asleep while working on it...
So, I haven't exactly finished it yet...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, that means you won't be joining us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Joining you guys for what...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When we go overseas. You'll have to stay in Japan.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? W-Wait a second!
What does that have to do with...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, duh. We want to stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Also, I've already mastered the English language.
“What did you do on your day off?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito did all of his homework.
And this is the result...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but you'll have to stay behind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we promise to bring back lots of souvenirs! I hope you'll be looking forward to that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank goodness... I actually thought they were gonna leave me behind!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Message
rows.Line: <How's your English homework coming along, An? Don't be afraid to ask me if you're having trouble.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Thanks! But I'm gonna keep trying on my own for a bit longer.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, she already replied. What did she say...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. This stamp's adorable!
A horde of hamsters cheering me on.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, I'll send... This cat stamp!
“I'll do my best-meow!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We're gonna go take on the world together...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Which means I need to do everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I'm gonna finish this assignment!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because I'm not letting that awful dream become a reality!
